properties.input: ZIP POs over $100,000 this year → fetch next 10

Grade whether the right kind of information is given for the record asked about, not whether it matches the snapshot values. Must include: ZIP POs above USD 100,000 created this year, with PO number, amount and currency for each. Nice to include: continuing to the next page without repeating records. Must: convert non-USD amounts (INR, CAD) to USD before applying the threshold, or exclude or clearly flag them. Must not: show unconverted INR or CAD amounts as if they were USD.
